class Algebra.IsFiniteSplit (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] : Prop where

instance {T : Type*} [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [IsFiniteSplit R S] :

  obtain ⟨n, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Algebra.IsFiniteSplit.nonempty_algEquiv_fun R S
  refine ⟨n, ⟨?_⟩⟩
